title: Constructible finite-coefficient complexes
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring and $T$ a scheme. A sheaf of $\Lambda_T$-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] on
the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] $T_{\Et}$ is *lisse* if it is
locally constant with finite stalks, i.e. finite locally constant as a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules [def-constructible-finite-locally-constant], and
*constructible* if $T$ admits a finite partition by locally closed
constructible subschemes on each of which the restriction is lisse [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. A complex
$K\in D(T_{\Et},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] is *bounded constructible* if every cohomology sheaf $\mathcal
H^i(K)$ [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves] is constructible and there are integers $a\leq b$ with $\mathcal
H^i(K)=0$ for $i\notin[a,b]$. The corresponding full subcategory
is denoted

$$
 \Dbc(T_{\Et},\Lambda)\subset D(T_{\Et},\Lambda).
$$

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against its blueprint source (master; no slopmaster2 copy differs: the node has no Lean on either branch) and against Stacks 03RU (finite locally constant), 03RW (constructible, affine-local) and 095E(3) (the global finite partition into constructible locally closed subschemes, equivalent to 03RW for qcqs T; for Lambda finite, 'of finite type and locally constant' is 'finite locally constant'). Statement kept for finite commutative rings only (no Q-bar_l convention here, as the reviewers asked); added 'T a scheme' and the citations of the notions. Statement dependencies named: the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]; Lambda_T and its module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]; lisse = finite locally constant as a sheaf of Lambda-modules [def-constructible-finite-locally-constant, closed on slopmaster2 as Scheme.IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf with A = ModuleCat Lambda]; constructibility, the new unsplit definition def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf (a stratification [def-constructible-stratification] with constructible strata [def-weil-constructible-subset, Mathlib] on whose strata the inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] is finite locally constant), which is not def-constructible-constructible: that node (and its Lean Scheme.IsConstructibleSheaf) does not ask the strata to be constructible, so for non-Noetherian T it admits e.g. j_! of a constant sheaf along a non-retrocompact open; D(T_et,Lambda) [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]; the cohomology sheaves H^i [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves, Mathlib leaf for any ringed site]. Boundedness (H^i = 0 outside [a,b]) is elementary. The statement only defines a full subcategory and claims no triangulated structure, so no lemma is hidden. Mathlib has the etale site, its points, Sheaf.IsConstant, IsConstructible/IsLocallyClosed for subsets and DerivedCategory, but no locally constant or constructible sheaves.
